abdera.name: Abdera
abdera.description: An implementation of the Atom Syndication Format and Atom Publishing Protocol.

accumulo.name: Accumulo
accumulo.description:
Accumulo is a distributed key/value store that provides expressive, cell-level
            access labels.

ace.name: ACE
ace.description:
A software distribution framework based on OSGi that allows you to manage and
            distribute artifacts.

activemq.name: ActiveMQ
activemq.description:
A robust and high performance Message Orientated Middleware provider which will
            be integrated into Apache Geronimo but also be usable from inside any JVM.

age.name: AGE
age.description:
AGE is a multi-model database that enables graph and relational models built on
            PostgreSQL.

agila.name: Agila
agila.description: Extensible Business Process Management (BPM) engine core.

airavata.name: Airavata
airavata.description:
A software suite to compose, manage, execute, and monitor large scale
            applications and workflows on computational resources ranging from local clusters to
            national grids and computing clouds.

airflow.name: Airflow
airflow.description:
Airflow is a workflow automation and scheduling system that can be used to
            author and manage data pipelines.

allura.name: Allura
allura.description:
Forge software for the development of software projects, including source
            control systems, issue tracking, discussion, wiki, and other software project management
            tools.

alois.name: Alois
alois.description:
ALOIS is a log collection and correlation software with reporting and alarming
            functionalities.

altrmi.name: AltRMI
altrmi.description: A transparent Remote Procedure Call bean.

amaterasu.name: Amaterasu
amaterasu.description:
Apache Amaterasu is a framework providing continuous deployment for Big Data
            pipelines.

ambari.name: Ambari
ambari.description:
Ambari is a monitoring, administration and lifecycle management project for
            Apache Hadoop clusters. (Formerly known as HMS)

amber.name: Amber
amber.description:
The Amber project will deliver a Java development framework mainly aimed to
            build OAuth-aware applications. Amber graduated with the name Apache Oltu

amoro.name: Amoro
amoro.description:
Amoro is a Lakehouse management system built on open data lake formats like
            Apache Iceberg and Apache Paimon.

annotator.name: Annotator
annotator.description: Annotator provides annotation enabling code for browsers, servers, and humans.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: A Q-and-A platform software for teams at any scales.

any23.name: Any23
any23.description:
Anything To Triples (any23) is a library, a web service and a command line tool
            that extracts structured data in RDF format from a variety of Web documents.

apex.name: Apex
apex.description:
Apex is an enterprise grade native YARN big data-in-motion platform that
            unifies stream processing as well as batch processing.

apisix.name: APISIX
apisix.description:
APISIX is a cloud-native microservices API gateway, delivering the ultimate
            performance, security,open source and scalable platform for all your APIs and
            microservices.

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.description:
A robust implementation of the OASIS WS-ResourceFramework (WSRF) family of
            specifications

ariatosca.name: AriaTosca
ariatosca.description:
ARIA TOSCA project offers an easily consumable Software Development Kit(SDK)
            and a Command Line Interface(CLI) to implement TOSCA(Topology and Orchestration
            Specification of Cloud Applications) based solutions.

aries.name: Aries
aries.description:
The Aries project will deliver a set of pluggable Java components enabling an
            enterprise OSGi application programming model.

asterixdb.name: AsterixDB
asterixdb.description:
Apache AsterixDB is a scalable big data management system (BDMS) that provides
            storage, management, and query capabilities for large collections of semi-structured
            data.

asyncband.name: Asyncband
asyncband.description: Asyncband is a runtime-agnostic library providing essential synchronization primitives for asynchronous Rust programming.

atlas.name: Atlas
atlas.description:
Apache Atlas is a scalable and extensible set of core foundational governance
            services that enables enterprises to effectively and efficiently meet their compliance
            requirements within Hadoop and allows integration with the complete enterprise data
            ecosystem

auron.name: Auron
auron.description:
Auron accelerates Apache Spark SQL by providing an alternative vectorized
            execution layer implemented in Rust, enabling native performance while maintaining full
            Spark compatibility.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: Aurora is a service scheduler used to schedule jobs onto Apache Mesos.

awf.name: AWF
awf.description:
AWF is a non-blocking, asynchronous, event driven high performance web
            framework running on the JVM. (Note: originally known as Deft, renamed to AWF on
            2012-02-15)

axion.name: Axion
axion.description: Relational database engine written in Java.

baremaps.name: Baremaps
baremaps.description:
Apache Baremaps is a toolkit and a set of infrastructure components for
            creating, publishing, and operating online maps.

batchee.name: BatchEE
batchee.description:
BatchEE projects aims to provide a JBatch implementation (aka JSR352) and a
            set of useful extensions for this specification.

beam.name: Beam
beam.description:
Apache Beam is an open source, unified model and set of language-specific SDKs
            for defining and executing data processing workflows, and also data ingestion and
            integration flows, supporting Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs) and Domain Specific
            Languages (DSLs). Dataflow pipelines simplify the mechanics of large-scale batch and
            streaming data processing and can run on a number of runtimes like Apache Flink, Apache
            Spark, and Google Cloud Dataflow (a cloud service). Beam also brings DSL in different
            languages, allowing users to easily implement their data integration processes.

beanvalidation.name: Bean Validation
beanvalidation.description:
The Bean Validation project will create an implementation of Bean Validation as
            defined by the Java EE specifications.

beehive.name: Beehive
beehive.description:
Extensible Java application framework with an integrated metadata-driven
            programming model for web services, web applications, and resource access

bifromq.name: BifroMQ
bifromq.description:
BifroMQ is a Java-based, high-performance, distributed MQTT broker with native
            multi-tenancy support, designed for large-scale connections and message delivery.

bigtop.name: Bigtop
bigtop.description:
Bigtop is a project for the development of packaging and tests of the Hadoop
            ecosystem.

bloodhound.name: Bloodhound
bloodhound.description:
Bloodhound is a software development collaboration tool, including issue
            tracking, wiki and repository browsing.

bluemarlin.name: BlueMarlin
bluemarlin.description:
BlueMarlin will develop a web service to add intelligence functionality to a
            plain ad system.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description:
Blur is a search platform capable of searching massive amounts of data in a
            cloud computing environment.

brooklyn.name: Brooklyn
brooklyn.description:
Brooklyn is a framework for modelling, monitoring, and managing applications
            through autonomic blueprints.

brpc.name: brpc
brpc.description:
brpc is an industrial-grade RPC framework for building reliable and
            high-performance services.

buildr.name: Buildr
buildr.description:
Buildr is a simple and intuitive build system for Java projects written in
            Ruby.

burr.name: Burr
burr.description:
Burr is a lightweight in-process python framework that standardizes the
            expression and execution of state machines as action-driven graphs, while making graph
            execution easily observable. It is particularly suited for AI agent workflows,
            simulations, and other dynamic systems, and comes with a self-hostable observability UI
            that integrates with OpenTelemetry.

caldera.name: Caldera
caldera.description:
Caldera provides a modular platform for modeling, scripting, and executing
            adversary behavior. It allows users to construct emulation plans, provides agents for
            communicating with the command and control server, and enables users to evaluate
            security detections in a structured, scalable, and repeatable way. With the use of
            plug-ins and community-contributed features, Caldera supports a range of use cases
            including adversary emulation, purple teaming, detection engineering, and continuous
            security validation. Using Caldera, defenders can emulate known threat actor behavior
            and perform other red team activity to evaluate their organization’s defensive
            capabilities, test analytics, and find detection gaps. As a modular tool based on the
            MITRE ATT&CK framework, Caldera is designed to be extensible, intelligence-driven,
            and automation-friendly.

calcite.name: Calcite
calcite.description:
Calcite is a highly customizable engine for parsing and planning queries on
            data in a wide variety of formats. It allows database-like access, and in particular a
            SQL interface and advanced query optimization, for data not residing in a traditional
            database. (Renamed from Optiq on 2014-09-30.)

carbondata.name: CarbonData
carbondata.description:
Apache CarbonData is a new Apache Hadoop native file format for faster
            interactive query using advanced columnar storage, index, compression and encoding
            techniques to improve computing efficiency, in turn it will help speedup queries an
            order of magnitude faster over PetaBytes of data.

celeborn.name: Celeborn
celeborn.description:
Celeborn is an intermediate data service for big data computing engines to
            boost performance, stability, and flexibility.

cmda.name: Climate Model Diagnostic Analyzer
cmda.description:
CMDA provides web services for multi-aspect physics-based and
            phenomenon-oriented climate model performance evaluation and diagnosis through the
            comprehensive and synergistic use of multiple observational data, reanalysis data, and
            model outputs.

cloudberry.name: Cloudberry
cloudberry.description:
Cloudberry Database, built on the latest PostgreSQL kernel, is one of the most
            advanced and mature open-source MPP (Massively Parallel Processing) databases available.

concerted.name: Concerted
concerted.description:
Apache Concerted is a Do-It-Yourself toolkit for building in-memory data
            engines.

cordova.name: Cordova
cordova.description:
Apache Cordova is a platform for building native mobile applications using
            HTML, CSS and JavaScript (formerly Phonegap). The project entered incubation as
            Callback, but decided to change its name to Cordova on 2011-11-28.

celix.name: Celix
celix.description:
Celix is an OSGi like implementation in C with a distinct focus on
            interoperability between Java and C.

chukwa.name: Chukwa
chukwa.description: Chukwa is a log collection and analysis framework for Apache Hadoop clusters.

clerezza.name: Clerezza
clerezza.description:
an OSGi-based modular application and set of components (bundles) for building
            RESTFul Semantic Web applications and services.

cloudstack.name: CloudStack
cloudstack.description:
CloudStack is an IaaS ("Infrastracture as a Service") cloud orchestration
            platform.

commonsrdf.name: CommonsRDF
commonsrdf.description:
Commons RDF is a set of interfaces and classes for RDF 1.1 concepts and
            behaviours. The commons-rdf-api module defines interfaces and testing harness. The
            commons-rdf-simple module provides a basic reference implementation to exercise the test
            harness and clarify API contracts.

corinthia.name: Corinthia
corinthia.description:
Corinthia is a toolkit/application for converting between and editing common
            office file formats, with an initial focus on word processing. It is designed to cater
            for multiple classes of platforms - desktop, web, and mobile - and relies heavily on web
            technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for representing and manipulating
            documents. The toolkit is small, portable, and flexible, with minimal dependencies. The
            target audience is developers wishing to include office viewing, conversion, and editing
            functionality into their applications.

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.description:
Cotton is an Apache Mesos framework for running MySQL instances. (Formerly
            known as Mysos)

crail.name: Crail
crail.description:
Crail is a storage platform for sharing performance critical data in
            distributed data processing jobs at very high speed.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.description:
Crunch is a Java library for writing, testing, and running pipelines of
            MapReduce jobs on Apache Hadoop.

ctakes.name: cTAKES
ctakes.description:
cTAKES (clinical Text Analysis and Knowledge Extraction System) is an natural
            language processing tool for information extraction from electronic medical record
            clinical free-text.

curator.name: Curator
curator.description: Curator - ZooKeeper client wrapper and rich ZooKeeper framework

cxf.name: CXF
cxf.description:
The CXF project will create a SOA services framework by merges the ObjectWeb
            Celtix project and the Codehaus XFire project.

daffodil.name: Daffodil
daffodil.description:
Apache Daffodil is an implementation of the Data Format Description Language
            (DFDL) used to convert between fixed format data and XML/JSON.

datafu.name: DataFu
datafu.description:
DataFu provides a collection of Hadoop MapReduce jobs and functions in higher
            level languages based on it to perform data analysis. It provides functions for common
            statistics tasks (e.g. quantiles, sampling), PageRank, stream sessionization, and set
            and bag operations. DataFu also provides Hadoop jobs for incremental data processing in
            MapReduce.

datasketches.name: DataSketches
datasketches.description:
DataSketches is an open source, high-performance library of stochastic
            streaming algorithms commonly called "sketches" in the data sciences. Sketches are
            small, stateful programs that process massive data as a stream and can provide
            approximate answers, with mathematical guarantees, to computationally difficult queries
            orders-of-magnitude faster than traditional, exact methods.

deltacloud.name: Deltacloud
deltacloud.description: Deltacloud, cloud API (REST) and abstraction framework

deltaspike.name: DeltaSpike
deltaspike.description:
DeltaSpike is a collection of JSR-299 (CDI) Extensions for building
            applications on the Java SE and EE platforms.

depot.name: Depot
depot.description:
Integrated tools for automating downloading, publishing and managing software
            artifacts, along with tools for manipulating their metadata.

devicemap.name: DeviceMap
devicemap.description:
Apache DeviceMap is a data repository containing device information, images and
            other relevant information for all sorts of mobile devices, e.g. smartphones and
            tablets. While the focus is initially on that data, APIs will also be created to use and
            manage it.

directmemory.name: DirectMemory
directmemory.description:
DirectMemory's main purpose is to to act as a second level cache able to store
            large amounts of data without filling up the Java heap and thus avoiding long garbage
            collection cycles.

distributedlog.name: DistributedLog
distributedlog.description:
DistributedLog is a high-performance replicated log service. It offers
            durability, replication and strong consistency, which provides a fundamental building
            block for building reliable distributed systems.

datalab.name: DataLab
datalab.description:
DataLab is a platform for creating self-service, exploratory data science
            environments in the cloud using best-of-breed data science tools.

devlake.name: DevLake
devlake.description:
DevLake is a development data platform, providing the data infrastructure for
            developer teams to analyze and improve their engineering productivity.

dolphinscheduler.name: DolphinScheduler
dolphinscheduler.description:
DolphinScheduler is a distributed ETL scheduling engine with powerful DAG
            visualization interface..

doris.name: Doris
doris.description:
Doris is a MPP-based interactive SQL data warehousing for reporting and
            analysis.

drill.name: Drill
drill.description:
Drill is a distributed system for interactive analysis of large-scale datasets,
            inspired by Google's Dremel.

droids.name: Droids
droids.description:
Droids aims to be an intelligent standalone robot framework that allows to
            create and extend existing droids (robots).

druid.name: Druid
druid.description: Druid is a high-performance, column-oriented, distributed data store.

dubbo.name: Dubbo
dubbo.description: Dubbo is a high-performance, lightweight, java based RPC framework.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.description:
Apache Eagle is an open source analytics solution for identifying security and
            performance issues instantly on big data platforms, e.g. Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark. It
            analyzes data activities, yarn applications, jmx metrics, and daemon logs etc., provides
            state-of-the-art alert engine to identify security breach, performance issues and shows
            insights.

easyant.name: EasyAnt
easyant.description: Easyant is a build system based on Apache Ant and Apache Ivy.

echarts.name: ECharts
echarts.description: ECharts is a charting and data visualization library written in JavaScript.

edgent.name: Edgent
edgent.description:
Edgent is a stream processing programming model and lightweight runtime to
            execute analytics at devices on the edge or at the gateway. (Formerly known as Quarks)

esme.name: ESME
esme.description:
Enterprise Social Messaging Experiment (ESME) is a secure and highly scalable
            microsharing and micromessaging platform that allows people to discover and meet one
            another and get controlled access to other sources of information, all in a business
            process context.

etch.name: Etch
etch.description:
A cross-platform, language- and transport-independent framework for building
            and consuming network services.

eventmesh.name: EventMesh
eventmesh.description:
EventMesh is a new generation serverless event middleware for building
            distributed event-driven applications.

falcon.name: Falcon
falcon.description:
A data processing and management solution for Hadoop designed for data motion,
            coordination of data pipelines, lifecycle management, and data discovery.

felix.name: Felix
felix.description: Implementation of the OSGi R4 specification. (Formerly known as Oscar)

fesod.name: Fesod
fesod.description:
Fesod is a high-performance and memory-efficient Java library for reading and
            writing Excel files, designed to simplify development and ensure reliability.

fineract.name: Fineract
fineract.description: Fineract is an open source system for core banking as a platform.

flagon.name: Flagon
flagon.description: Flagon is a software tool usability testing platform

flex.name: Flex
flex.description: Application framework for building Flash-based applications.

flink.name: Flink
flink.description:
Flink is an open source system for expressive, declarative, fast, and efficient
            data analysis. Stratosphere combines the scalability and programming flexibility of
            distributed MapReduce-like platforms with the efficiency, out-of-core execution, and
            query optimization capabilities found in parallel databases. Flink was originally known
            as Stratosphere when it entered the Incubator.

flume.name: Flume
flume.description:
Flume is a distributed, reliable, and available system for efficiently
            collecting, aggregating, and moving large amounts of log data from many different
            sources to a centralized data store.

fluo.name: Fluo
fluo.description:
Fluo is a distributed system for incrementally processing large data sets
            stored in Accumulo.

fluss.name: Fluss
fluss.description:
Fluss is a streaming storage built for real-time analytics which can serve as
            the real-time data layer for Lakehouse architectures.

freemarker.name: FreeMarker
freemarker.description:
FreeMarker is a template engine, i.e. a generic tool to generate text output
            based on templates. FreeMarker is implemented in Java as a class library for
            programmers.

ftpserver.name: FtpServer
ftpserver.description: A complete FTP Server based on Mina I/O system.

fory.name: Fory
fory.description:
A blazing fast multi-language serialization framework powered by jit and
            zero-copy

geaflow.name: GeaFlow
geaflow.description: GeaFlow is a distributed stream and batch integration graph compute engine.

gearpump.name: Gearpump
gearpump.description:
Gearpump is a reactive real-time streaming engine based on the micro-service
            Actor model.

giraph.name: Giraph
giraph.description:
Giraph is a large-scale, fault-tolerant, Bulk Synchronous Parallel (BSP)-based
            graph processing framework.

gluten.name: Gluten
gluten.description:
Gluten is a middle layer responsible for offloading JVM-based SQL engines'
            execution to native engines.

gora.name: Gora
gora.description:
Gora is an ORM framework for column stores such as Apache HBase and Apache
            Cassandra with a specific focus on Hadoop.

gossip.name: Gossip
gossip.description: Gossip is an implementation of the Gossip Protocol.

graffito.name: Graffito
graffito.description: Portal oriented Content Management System (Formerly known as JCMS)

graphar.name: GraphAr
graphar.description:
GraphAr is an open-source and language-independent data file format designed
            for efficient graph data storage and retrieval.

gravitino.name: Gravitino
gravitino.description:
Gravitino is a high-performance, geo-distributed, and federated metadata like
            designed to manage metadata seamlessly across diverse data sources, vendors, and
            regions. Its primary goal is to provide users with unified metadata access for both data
            and AI assets.

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.description:
Griffin is a open source Data Quality solution for distributed data systems at
            any scale in both streaming or batch data context

guacamole.name: Guacamole
guacamole.description:
Guacamole is an enterprise-grade, protocol-agnostic, remote desktop gateway.
            Combined with cloud hosting, Guacamole provides an excellent alternative to traditional
            desktops. Guacamole aims to make cloud-hosted desktop access preferable to traditional,
            local access.

geode.name: Geode
geode.description:
Geode is a data management platform that provides real-time, consistent access
            to data-intensive applications throughout widely distributed cloud architectures.

gobblin.name: Gobblin
gobblin.description:
Gobblin is a distributed data integration framework that simplifies common
            aspects of big data integration such as data ingestion, replication, organization and
            lifecycle management for both streaming and batch data ecosystems.

grails.name: Grails
grails.description:
A powerful Groovy-based web application framework for the JVM built on top of
            Spring Boot

groovy.name: Groovy
groovy.description:
Groovy is an object-oriented programming language for the Java platform. It is
            a language with features similar to those of Python, Ruby, Java, Perl, and Smalltalk.

hama.name: Hama
hama.description:
Hama is a distributed computing framework based on BSP (Bulk Synchronous
            Parallel) computing techniques for massive scientific computations, e.g., matrix, graph
            and network algorithms.

hamilton.name: Hamilton
hamilton.description:
Hamilton is a lightweight in-process framework to define, execute, and observe
            directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) that express data transformations. In Hamilton, one can
            express complex DAGs of transformations, e.g. from dataframe transformations (using
            pandas, polars, PySpark), machine learning pipelines, through to regular software
            engineering API request and LLM API based workflows. Observability hooks are built into
            the framework. The Hamilton UI is a self-hostable service to capture observability
            output from workflow runs.

hawq.name: HAWQ
hawq.description:
HAWQ is an advanced enterprise SQL on Hadoop analytic engine built around a
            robust and high-performance massively-parallel processing (MPP) SQL framework evolved
            from Pivotal Greenplum Database.

horn.name: HORN
horn.description:
HORN is a neuron-centric programming APIs and execution framework for
            large-scale deep learning, built on top of Apache Hama.

hcatalog.name: HCatalog
hcatalog.description:
HCatalog is a table and storage management service for data created using
            Apache Hadoop.

hdt.name: Hadoop Development Tools (HDT)
hdt.description: Eclipse based tools for developing applications on the Hadoop platform

helix.name: Helix
helix.description:
Apache Helix is a generic cluster management framework used to build
            distributed systems and provides automatic partition management, fault tolerance and
            elasticity.

heraldry.name: Heraldry
heraldry.description: Identity for the rest of us.

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.description:
A robust implementation of the OASIS WS-Notification (WSN) family of
            specifications

heron.name: Heron
heron.description: A real-time, distributed, fault-tolerant stream processing engine.

hertzbeat.name: HertzBeat
hertzbeat.description:
HertzBeat is an easy-to-use, open source, real-time monitoring system. It
            features an agentless architecture, high-performance clustering, Prometheus
            compatibility, and powerful custom monitoring and status page building capabilities.

hivemall.name: Hivemall
hivemall.description:
Hivemall is a library for machine learning implemented as Hive
            UDFs/UDAFs/UDTFs.

hop.name: Hop
hop.description:
Hop is short for the Hop Orchestration Platform. Written completely in Java it
            aims to provide a wide range of data orchestration tools, including a visual development
            environment, servers, metadata analysis, auditing services and so on. As a platform, Hop
            also wants to be a reusable library so that it can be easily reused by other software.

horaedb.name: HoraeDB
horaedb.description: HoraeDB is a high-performance, distributed, cloud native time-series database.

htrace.name: HTrace
htrace.description:
HTrace is a tracing framework intended for use with distributed systems written
            in java.

httpd-cli.name: httpd-CLI
httpd-cli.description: CLI integration project for httpd server

hugegraph.name: HugeGraph
hugegraph.description: A large-scale and easy-to-use graph database

hudi.name: Hudi
hudi.description: Hudi provides atomic upserts and incremental data streams on Big Data

ibatis.name: iBATIS
ibatis.description:
The iBATIS Data Mapper framework makes it easier to use a database with Java or
            .NET applications. iBATIS couples objects with stored procedures or SQL statements using
            a XML descriptor.

iceberg.name: Iceberg
iceberg.description: Iceberg is a table format for large, slow-moving tabular data.

iggy.name: Iggy
iggy.description:
Iggy is a high-performance, ultra-low latency and large-scale persistent
            message streaming platform written in Rust.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.description:
A unified In-Memory Data Fabric providing high-performance, distributed
            in-memory data management software layer between various data sources and user
            applications.

impala.name: Impala
impala.description:
Impala is a high-performance C++ and Java SQL query engine for data stored in
            Apache Hadoop-based clusters.

iota.name: iota
iota.description: Open source system that enables the orchestration of IoT devices.

iotdb.name: IoTDB
iotdb.description:
IoTDB is a data store for managing large amounts of time series data such as
            timestamped data from IoT sensors in industrial applications.

isis.name: Isis
isis.description:
The Isis project will be an extensible standards-based framework to rapidly
            develop and enterprise level deploy domain-driven (DDD) applications.

ivy.name: Ivy
ivy.description: A java based tool for tracking, resolving and managing project dependencies.

jackrabbit.name: Jackrabbit
jackrabbit.description: Content Repository API based on JSR 170

jaxme.name: JaxMe
jaxme.description: Implementation of JAXB, the specification for Java/XML binding

jclouds.name: jclouds
jclouds.description:
A cloud agnostic library that enables developers to access a variety of
            supported cloud providers using one API

jena.name: Jena
jena.description: Java framework for building Semantic Web applications.

johnzon.name: Johnzon
johnzon.description: Implementation of JSR-353 JavaTM API for JSON Processing (Renamed from Fleece)

joshua.name: Joshua
joshua.description: Joshua is a statistical machine translation toolkit

juddi.name: jUDDI
juddi.description:
Implementation of a Universal Description Discovery and Integration (UDDI)
            registry

juice.name: JuiCE
juice.description:
OpenSSL based JCE provider. Project going into retired status after lack of
            community interest.

juneau.name: Juneau
juneau.description:
Apache Juneau is a toolkit for marshalling POJOs to a
        wide variety of content types using a common framework, and for creating sophisticated
        self-documenting REST interfaces and microservices using VERY little code.

kafka.name: Kafka
kafka.description:
Kafka is a distributed publish-subscribe system for processing large amounts of
            streaming data.

kalumet.name: Kalumet
kalumet.description:
Kalumet a complete environment manager and deployer including J2EE environments
            (application servers, applications, etc), softwares, and resources.

kato.name: Kato
kato.description:
Kato is a project to develop the Specification, Reference Implementation, and
            TCK for JSR 326: the JVM Post-mortem Diagnostics API.

kie.name: KIE
kie.description:
KIE (Knowledge is Everything) is a community of solutions and supporting
            tooling for knowledge engineering and process automation, focusing on events, rules, and
            workflows.

kitty.name: Kitty
kitty.description:
Kitty is a lightweight, production focused, Java-based application server
            performance diagnostic and management utility.

knox.name: Knox
knox.description:
Knox Gateway is a system that provides a single point of secure access for
            Apache Hadoop clusters.

kudu.name: Kudu
kudu.description:
Kudu is a distributed columnar storage engine built for the Apache Hadoop
            ecosystem.

kvrocks.name: Kvrocks
kvrocks.description:
Kvrocks is a distributed key-value NoSQL database, supporting the rich data
            structure

kylin.name: Kylin
kylin.description:
Kylin is a distributed and scalable OLAP engine built on Hadoop to support
            extremely large datasets.

kyuubi.name: Kyuubi
kyuubi.description:
Kyuubi is a distributed multi-tenant Thrift JDBC/ODBC server for large-scale
            data management, processing, and analytics, built on top of Apache Spark and designed to
            support more engines.

lens.name: Lens
lens.description:
Lens is a platform that enables multi-dimensional queries in a unified way over
            datasets stored in multiple warehouses. Lens integrates Apache Hive with other data
            warehouses by tiering them together to form logical data cubes.

lenya.name: Lenya
lenya.description: Content Management and publishing system based on Cocoon

libcloud.name: Libcloud
libcloud.description:
libcloud is a standard client library for many popular cloud providers, written
            in python

liminal.name: Liminal
liminal.description:
Apache Liminal is an end-to-end platform for data engineers and scientists,
            allowing them to build, train and deploy machine learning models in a robust and agile
            way.

linkis.name: Linkis
linkis.description:
Apache Linkis builds a
        computation middleware layer to facilitate connection, governance and orchestration between
        the upper applications and the underlying data engines.

livy.name: Livy
livy.description:
Livy is web service that exposes a REST interface for managing long running
            Apache Spark contexts in your cluster. With Livy, new applications can be built on top
            of Apache Spark that require fine grained interaction with many Spark contexts.

log4cxx.name: log4cxx
log4cxx.description: Logging for C++. N.B. the code has re-entered the Incubator as log4cxx2.

log4cxx2.name: log4cxx2
log4cxx2.description:
Logging for C++. N.B. This is a reboot of the Log4cxx podling which previously
            graduated.

lokahi.name: Lokahi
lokahi.description:
The Lokahi project will create a management console for Apache HTTP Server and
            Apache Tomcat projects on a framework extensible to other ASF projects.

lucene.net.name: Lucene.NET
lucene.net.description:
Lucene.NET is a source code, class-per-class, API-per-API and algorithmatic
            port of the Java Lucene search engine to the C# and .NET platform utilizing Microsoft
            .NET Framework.

lucy.name: Lucy
lucy.description:
A loose port of the Lucene search engine library, written in C and targeted at
            dynamic language users.

madlib.name: MADlib
madlib.description: Big Data Machine Learning in SQL for Data Scientists.

maka.name: Maka
maka.description: Maka is a local-first AI agent runtime and workspace. It records model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events in append-only logs.

manifoldcf.name: ManifoldCF
manifoldcf.description: Connectors for content repositories like Sharepoint, Documentum, etc.

marmotta.name: Marmotta
marmotta.description: An open implementation of a Linked Data Platform.

marvin.name: Marvin-AI
marvin.description:
Marvin-AI is an open-source artificial intelligence (AI) platform that helps
            data scientists, prototype and productionalize complex solutions with a scalable,
            low-latency, language-agnostic, and standardized architecture while simplifies the
            process of exploration and modeling.

merlin-developer.name: MerlinDeveloper
merlin-developer.description: Merlin eclipse plugin merged with an existing eclipse plugin already at avalon.

mesos.name: Mesos
mesos.description:
Mesos is a cluster manager that provides resource sharing and isolation across
            cluster applications.

metamodel.name: MetaModel
metamodel.description:
MetaModel is a data access framework, providing a common interface for
            exploration and querying of different types of datastores.

metron.name: Metron
metron.description:
Metron is a project dedicated to providing an extensible and scalable advanced
            network security analytics tool. It has strong foundations in the Apache Hadoop
            ecosystem.

milagro.name: Milagro
milagro.description:
Milagro is core security infrastructure and crypto libraries for decentralized
            networks and distributed systems.

mnemonic.name: Mnemonic
mnemonic.description:
Mnemonic is a Java based non-volatile memory library for in-place structured
            data processing and computing.

mod_ftp.name: mod_ftp
mod_ftp.description: FTP protocol module for Apache httpd 2.x

mrql.name: MRQL
mrql.description:
MRQL is a query processing and optimization system for large-scale, distributed
            data analysis, built on top of Apache Hadoop, Hama, Spark, and Flink.

mrunit.name: MRUnit
mrunit.description: MRUnit is a library to support unit testing of Hadoop MapReduce jobs.

muse.name: Muse
muse.description:
A robust implementation of the OASIS WSDM, Management using Web Services (MuWS)
            specification

mxnet.name: MXNet
mxnet.description: A Flexible and Efficient Library for Deep Learning

myfaces.name: MyFaces
myfaces.description:
MyFaces is a framework for building Java Server application GUIs based on
            JavaServer Faces (certified implementation of JSR-127).

mynewt.name: Mynewt
mynewt.description:
Mynewt is a real-time operating system for constrained embedded systems like
            wearables, lightbulbs, locks and doorbells. It works on a variety of 32-bit MCUs
            (microcontrollers), including ARM Cortex-M and MIPS architectures.

myriad.name: Myriad
myriad.description:
Myriad enables co-existence of
        Apache Hadoop YARN and Apache Mesos together on the same cluster and allows dynamic resource
        allocations across both Hadoop and other applications running on the same physical data
        center infrastructure.

nemo.name: Nemo
nemo.description:
Nemo is a data processing system to flexibly control the runtime behaviors of a
            job to adapt to varying deployment characteristics.

netbeans.name: NetBeans
netbeans.description:
NetBeans is a development environment, tooling platform and application
            framework.

nifi.name: NiFi
nifi.description: NiFi is a dataflow system based on the concepts of flow-based programming.

nmaven.name: NMaven
nmaven.description: .NET integration for Maven. Failed to build active community.

nlpcraft.name: NLPCraft
nlpcraft.description: A Java API for NLU applications

npanday.name: NPanday
npanday.description: NPanday allows projects using the .NET framework to be built with Apache Maven.

nullaway.name: NullAway
nullaway.description: NullAway is a fast, annotation-based nullness checker for Java that helps eliminate NullPointerExceptions at build time with minimal overhead.

nuttx.name: NuttX
nuttx.description: NuttX is a mature, real-time embedded operating system (RTOS).

nuvem.name: Nuvem
nuvem.description:
Nuvem defines an open application programming interface for common cloud
            application services, allowing applications to be easily ported across the most popular
            cloud platforms. The podling was voted to become part of Tuscany in Nov 2012 but (as of
            Aug 2014) nothing has happened. Tuscany was terminated in May 2016.

odftoolkit.name: ODF Toolkit
odftoolkit.description:
Java modules that allow programmatic creation, scanning and manipulation of
            OpenDocument Format (ISO/IEC 26300 == ODF) documents

ofbiz.name: OFBiz
ofbiz.description:
The Open For Business Project (OFBiz) is an open source enterprise automation
            software project.

ognl.name: OGNL
ognl.description: Object-Graph Notation Language implementation in Java

omid.name: Omid
omid.description:
Omid is a flexible, reliable, high performant and scalable ACID transactional
            framework that allows client applications to execute transactions on top of MVCC
            key/value-based NoSQL datastores (currently Apache HBase) providing Snapshot Isolation
            guarantees on the accessed data.

onami.name: Onami
onami.description:
Apache Onami aims to create a community focused on the development and
            maintenance of a set of Google Guice extensions not provided out of the box by the
            library itself nor the Google developers team, such as integration with 3rd part
            frameworks or extra functionalities.

oodt.name: OODT
oodt.description:
A grid middleware framework for science data processing, information
            integration, and retrieval.

oozie.name: Oozie
oozie.description:
Server-based workflow scheduling and coordination system to manage data
            processing jobs for Apache Hadoop

climate.name: Open Climate Workbench
climate.description:
A tool for scalable comparison of remote sensing observations to climate model
            outputs, regionally and globally.

openaz.name: OpenAz
openaz.description:
Tools and libraries for developing Attribute-based Access Control (ABAC)
            Systems in a variety of languages.

opendal.name: OpenDAL
opendal.description: Open Data Access Layer: Access data freely, painlessly, and efficiently.

openjpa.name: OpenJPA
openjpa.description: OpenJPA is an open source implementation of the Java Persistence API

openmeetings.name: Openmeetings
openmeetings.description: Openmeetings is a web conferencing solution.

opennlp.name: OpenNLP
opennlp.description:
OpenNLP is a machine learning based toolkit for the processing of natural
            language text.

openofficeorg.name: OpenOffice.org
openofficeorg.description:
OpenOffice.org is comprised of six personal productivity applications: a word
            processor (and its web-authoring component), spreadsheet, presentation graphics,
            drawing, equation editor, and database.

openserverless.name: OpenServerless
openserverless.description:
OpenServerless is an open source, cloud-agnostic, serverless platform. It
            offers a complete environment for serverless applications development, based on
            Kubernetes. With Apache OpenWhisk as its FaaS engine, it provides an unified developer
            experience with a plethora of services (SQL or noSQL databases, key-value stores, object
            storage, LLMs services, function schedulers) managed by the platform's core: the
            operator, along with tooling (the CLI) to simplify (and interact with) deployments,
            integrated ide and starter application and optimized runtimes integrated with the
            staters.

news.note: dev and private lists created; commits lists requested.
Moved 24/26 OpenWhisk project and ecosystem repositories from openwhisk to Apache organization within GitHub.
"Core" openwhisk (last source code) repo. moved under Apache GitHub.

ossie.name: Ossie
ossie.description:
Apache Ossie comes from Open Semantic Interchange. It is an open specification that 
            defines a vendor-neutral format for expressing business metrics, dimensions, and their 
            relationships. It enables any tool to consume and produce semantic definitions without loss 
            of meaning.

otava.name: Otava
otava.description:
Otava, a command-line tool, written in Python, that detects statistically
            significant changes in time-series data stored either in databases or CSV files. Otava
            entered Incubation as Hunter

ozhera.name: OzHera
ozhera.description:
OzHera is an application observation platform (APM) in the era of cloud native,
            with the application as its core, integrating capabilities such as metric monitoring,
            trace tracking, logging, and alerting

pagespeed.name: PageSpeed
pagespeed.description:
PageSpeed represents a series of open source technologies to help make the web
            faster by rewriting web pages to reduce latency and bandwidth.

paimon.name: Paimon
paimon.description:
Paimon is a unified lake storage to build dynamic tables for both stream and
            batch processing with big data compute engines, supporting high-speed data ingestion and
            real-time data query.

parquet.name: Parquet
parquet.description: Parquet is a columnar storage format for Hadoop.

pdfbox.name: PDFBox
pdfbox.description: PDF library (reading, text extraction, manipulation, viewer)

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description:
Pegasus is a distributed key-value storage system which is designed to be
            simple, horizontally scalable, strongly consistent and high-performance.

pekko.name: Pekko
pekko.description:
Pekko is a toolkit and an ecosystem for building highly concurrent,
            distributed, reactive and resilient applications for Java and Scala.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description:
Phoenix is an open source SQL query engine for Apache HBase, a NoSQL data
            store. It is accessed as a JDBC driver and enables querying and managing HBase tables
            using SQL.

photark.name: PhotArk
photark.description: A Photo Gallery application, accessible via the web and written in Java

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: Pig is a platform for analyzing large datasets.

pirk.name: Pirk
pirk.description: Pirk is a framework for scalable Private Information Retrieval (PIR).

pinot.name: Pinot
pinot.description:
Pinot is a distributed columnar storage engine that can ingest data in
            real-time and serve analytical queries at low latency.

pivot.name: Pivot
pivot.description: A platform for building rich internet applications in Java.

plc4x.name: PLC4X
plc4x.description:
PLC4X is a set of libraries for communicating with industrial programmable
            logic controllers (PLCs) using a variety of protocols but with a shared API.

polaris.name: Polaris
polaris.description:
Polaris is a catalog for data lakes. It provides new levels of choice,
            flexibility and control over data, with full enterprise security and Apache Iceberg
            interoperability across a multitude of engines and infrastructure.

ponymail.name: Pony Mail
ponymail.description:
Pony Mail is a mail-archiving, archive viewing, and interaction service, that
            can be integrated with many email platforms.

pouchdb.name: PouchDB
pouchdb.description:
PouchDB is an open-source JavaScript database inspired by Apache CouchDB that
            is designed to run well within the browser.

predictionio.name: PredictionIO
predictionio.description:
PredictionIO is an open source Machine Learning Server built on top of
            state-of-the-art open source stack, that enables developers to manage and deploy
            production-ready predictive services for various kinds of machine learning tasks.

provisionr.name: Provisionr
provisionr.description:
Provisionr provides a service to manage pools of virtual machines on multiple
            clouds.

pulsar.name: Pulsar
pulsar.description:
Pulsar is a highly scalable, low latency messaging platform running on
            commodity hardware. It provides simple pub-sub semantics over topics, guaranteed
            at-least-once delivery of messages, automatic cursor management for subscribers, and
            cross-datacenter replication.

quickstep.name: Quickstep
quickstep.description: Quickstep is a high-performance database engine.

qpid.name: Qpid
qpid.description:
Qpid provides multiple language implementations of the Advanced Messaged
            Queuing Protocol (AMQP)

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description:
The Ranger project is a framework to enable, monitor and manage comprehensive
            data security across the Hadoop platform. (The podling was originally called Argus)

rat.name: RAT
rat.description: Comprehension and auditing for distributions and source code

ratis.name: Ratis
ratis.description: Ratis is a java implementation for RAFT consensus protocol

rave.name: Rave
rave.description: Rave is A WEb And SOcial Mashup Engine.

reef.name: REEF
reef.description:
REEF (Retainable Evaluator Execution Framework) is a scale-out computing fabric
            that eases the development of Big Data applications on top of resource managers such as
            Apache YARN and Mesos.

resilientdb.name: ResilientDB
resilientdb.description:
ResilientDB is a distributed blockchain framework that is open-source,
            lightweight, modular, and highly performant.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.description:
Ripple is a browser based mobile phone emulator designed to aid in the
            development of HTML5 based mobile applications. Ripple is a cross platform and cross
            runtime testing/debugging tool. It currently supports such runtimes as Cordova, WebWorks
            aand the Mobile Web.

rocketmq.name: RocketMQ
rocketmq.description:
RocketMQ is a fast, low latency, reliable, scalable, distributed, easy to use
            message-oriented middleware, especially for processing large amounts of streaming data.

rya.name: Rya
rya.description:
Rya (pronounced "ree-uh" /rēə/) is a cloud-based RDF triple store that supports
            SPARQL queries. Rya is a scalable RDF data management system built on top of Accumulo.
            Rya uses novel storage methods, indexing schemes, and query processing techniques that
            scale to billions of triples across multiple nodes. Rya provides fast and easy access to
            the data through SPARQL, a conventional query mechanism for RDF data.

s2graph.name: S2Graph
s2graph.description:
S2Graph is a distributed and scalable OLTP graph database built on Apache HBase
            to support fast traversal of extremely large graphs.

s4.name: S4
s4.description:
S4 (Simple Scalable Streaming System) is a general-purpose, distributed,
            scalable, partially fault-tolerant, pluggable platform that allows programmers to easily
            develop applications for processing continuous, unbounded streams of data.

samoa.name: SAMOA
samoa.description:
SAMOA provides a collection of
        distributed streaming algorithms for the most common data mining and machine learning tasks
        such as classification, clustering, and regression, as well as programming abstractions to
        develop new algorithms that run on top of distributed stream processing engines (DSPEs). It
        features a pluggable architecture that allows it to run on several DSPEs such as Apache
        Storm, Apache S4, and Apache Samza.

samza.name: Samza
samza.description:
Samza is a stream processing system for running continuous computation on
            infinite streams of data.

sanselan.name: Sanselan
sanselan.description:
The Sanselan Project is a pure-java image library for reading and writing a
            variety of image formats.

sdap.name: SDAP
sdap.description: SDAP is an integrated data analytic center for Big Science problems.

seata.name: Seata
seata.description:
Seata(Simple Extensible Autonomous Transaction Architecture)is an easy-to-use
            and high-performance distributed transaction solution, used to solve the data
            consistency problem.

sedona.name: Sedona
sedona.description:
Sedona is a big geospatial data processing engine. It provides an easy to use
            APIs for spatial data scientists to manage, wrangle, and process geospatial data.

seatunnel.name: SeaTunnel
seatunnel.description:
SeaTunnel is a very easy-to-use ultra-high-performance distributed data
            integration platform that supports real-time synchronization of massive data.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.description:
Sentry is a highly modular system for providing fine grained role based
            authorization to both data and metadata stored on an Apache Hadoop cluster.

servicecomb.name: ServiceComb
servicecomb.description:
ServiceComb is a microservice framework that provides a set of tools and
            components to make development and deployment of cloud applications easier.

servicemix.name: ServiceMix
servicemix.description:
The ServiceMix project will create an ESB and component suite based on the Java
            Business Interface (JBI) standard - JSR 208.

spark.name: Spark
spark.description:
Spark is an open source system for fast and flexible large-scale data analysis.
            Spark provides a general purpose runtime that supports low-latency execution in several
            forms.

shardingsphere.name: ShardingSphere
shardingsphere.description:
ShardingSphere related to a database clustering system providing data sharding,
            distributed transactions, and distributed database management.

shenyu.name: ShenYu
shenyu.description:
ShenYu is a high performance Microservices API gateway in Java ecosystem,
            compatible with a variety of mainstream framework systems, it supports hot plugin
            loading.

shindig.name: Shindig
shindig.description: The Shindig Project is an OpenSocial container.

shiro.name: Shiro
shiro.description: Security framework. (Initially known as JSecurity or Ki, renamed June 2009)

singa.name: SINGA
singa.description: SINGA is a distributed deep learning platform.

sis.name: SIS
sis.description:
The Spatial Information System (SIS) Project is a toolkit that spatial
            information system builders or users can leverage to build applications containing
            location context.

skywalking.name: SkyWalking
skywalking.description:
Skywalking is an APM (application performance monitor), especially for
            microservice, Cloud Native and container-based architecture systems. Also known as a
            distributed tracing system. It provides an automatic way to instrument applications: no
            need to change any of the source code of the target application; and an collector with
            an very high efficiency streaming module.

slider.name: Slider
slider.description:
Slider is a collection of tools and technologies to package, deploy, and manage
            long running applications on Apache Hadoop YARN clusters.

sling.name: Sling
sling.description:
Sling is a framework to develop content centric web applications based on the
            idea of modularizing the rendering of HTTP resources.

socialsite.name: SocialSite
socialsite.description:
SocialSite is an OpenSocial-based headless social networking server and a set
            of OpenSocial Gadgets that make it easy to add social features to existing web sites.
            Server provides admin console for configuration, gadget approval and management. Gadgets
            can be combined to form complete UI for social networking with friending, group
            management and message support.

spot.name: Spot
spot.description:
Apache Spot is a platform for network telemetry built on an open data model and
            Apache Hadoop.

sqoop.name: Sqoop
sqoop.description:
Sqoop is a tool designed for efficiently transferring bulk data between Apache
            Hadoop and structured datastores such as relational databases.

stanbol.name: Stanbol
stanbol.description:
A modular software stack and reusable set of components for semantic content
            management

stdcxx.name: stdcxx
stdcxx.description:
The Apache C++ Standard Library project is a complete implementation of the
            ISO/IEC 14882 C++ Standard Library.

stonehenge.name: Stonehenge
stonehenge.description:
Stonehenge is a set of interoperability scenarios for Service Oriented
            Architecture and Web Services that demonstrate interoperability between multiple systems
            including Apache Axis2, WSF/PHP and Microsoft WCF. The code also demonstrates good
            practice for standards-based interoperability.

storm.name: Storm
storm.description:
Storm is a distributed, fault-tolerant, and high-performance realtime
            computation system that provides strong guarantees on the processing of data.

stormcrawler.name: StormCrawler
stormcrawler.description:
StormCrawler is a collection of resources for building low-latency,
            customisable and scalable web crawlers on Apache Storm.

stratos.name: Stratos
stratos.description:
Stratos will be a polyglot PaaS framework, providing developers a cloud-based
            environment for developing, testing, and running scalable applications, and IT providers
            high utilization rates, automated resource management, and platform-wide insight
            including monitoring and billing.

streampark.name: StreamPark
streampark.description: StreamPark is a streaming application development platform.

streampipes.name: StreamPipes
streampipes.description:
StreamPipes is a self-service (Industrial) IoT toolbox to enable non-technical
            users to connect, analyze and explore (Industrial) IoT data streams.

streams.name: Streams
streams.description: Apache Streams is a lightweight server for ActivityStreams.

subversion.name: Subversion
subversion.description:
Subversion is an open-source version control system, with a long and detailed
            list of features. (See http://subversion.apache.org/features.html)

superset.name: Superset
superset.description:
Superset is an enterprise-ready web application for data exploration, data
            visualization and dashboarding.

syncope.name: Syncope
syncope.description:
An Open Source system for managing digital identities in enterprise
            environments, implemented in JEE technology

systemml.name: SystemML
systemml.description:
SystemML provides declarative large-scale machine learning (ML) that aims at
            flexible specification of ML algorithms and automatic generation of hybrid runtime plans
            ranging from single node, in-memory computations, to distributed computations such as
            Apache Hadoop MapReduce and Apache Spark.

tajo.name: Tajo
tajo.description: Tajo is a distributed data warehouse system for Hadoop.

tapestry.name: Tapestry
tapestry.description: Alternative framework to JSP and Velocity scripting environments

tashi.name: Tashi
tashi.description: An infrastructure for cloud computing on big data.

tamaya.name: Tamaya
tamaya.description:
Tamaya is a highly flexible configuration solution based on an modular,
            extensible and injectable key/value based design, which should provide a minimal but
            extendible modern and functional API leveraging SE, ME and EE environments.

taverna.name: Taverna
taverna.description:
Taverna is a domain-independent suite of tools used to design and execute
            data-driven workflows.

teaclave.name: Teaclave
teaclave.description: Teaclave is a universal secure computing platform.

tephra.name: Tephra
tephra.description:
Tephra is a system for providing globally consistent transactions on top of
            Apache HBase and other storage engines.

texera.name: Texera
texera.description:
Texera is an open-source system to support collaborative data science, AI, and
            ML using GUI-based workflows. Our vision is to develop a system to support cloud
            platforms on which users can easily analyze data and use AI/ML techniques provided as
            operators. Users with various backgrounds, irrespective of whether they know coding or
            not, can collaborate on the same project to construct a pipeline. Experienced users can
            use programming languages such as Python, R, Java, and Scala to implement customized
            computation logic. The platform allows users to pause the execution of a workflow to
            investigate the operator states, and resume the execution at a later time. The platform
            can be used by a research community to publish valuable resources such as data sets,
            workflows, and ML models to share their domain-specific knowledge and support
            reproducibility of scientific research. The platform also allows users to elastically
            request computing resources from public clouds for computationally-intensive tasks.

tez.name: Tez
tez.description:
Tez is an effort to develop a generic application framework which can be used
            to process arbitrarily complex data-processing tasks and also a re-usable set of
            data-processing primitives which can be used by other projects.

tinkerpop.name: TinkerPop
tinkerpop.description: TinkerPop is a graph computing framework written in Java

tobago.name: Tobago
tobago.description: A JSF based framework for web-applications.

toree.name: Toree
toree.description:
Toree provides applications with a mechanism to interactively and remotely
            access Apache Spark.

trafficcontrol.name: Traffic Control
trafficcontrol.description:
Apache Traffic Control can be used to build, monitor, configure, and provision
            a large-scale content delivery network (CDN).

trafficserver.name: Traffic Server
trafficserver.description: A scalable and extensible HTTP proxy server and cache.

trafodion.name: Trafodion
trafodion.description:
Trafodion is a webscale SQL-on-Hadoop solution enabling transactional or
            operational workloads on Hadoop.

training.name: Training
training.description:
The Training project aims to develop resources which can be used for training
            purposes in various media formats, languages and for various Apache and non-Apache
            target projects.

trinidad.name: Trinidad
trinidad.description: JSF Component Library. Known as ADF Faces during initial incubation

triplesoup.name: TripleSoup
triplesoup.description:
SPARQL endpoint for your webserver. Project entering retired status after
            failing to get traction.

tsik.name: TSIK
tsik.description:
implementations of various W3C and OASIS specifications related to XML and Web
            services security

inlong.name: InLong
inlong.description:
InLong is a one-stop data integration framework that provides automatic,
            secure, and reliable data transmission capabilities. InLong supports both batch and
            stream data processing at the same time, which offers great power to build data
            analysis, modeling, and other real-time applications based on streaming data.

tuweni.name: Tuweni
tuweni.description:
Tuweni is a set of libraries and other tools to aid development of blockchain
            and other decentralized software in Java and other JVM languages.

tvm.name: TVM
tvm.description:
TVM is a full stack open deep learning compiler stack for CPUs, GPUs, and
            specialized accelerators. It aims to close the gap between the productivity-focused deep
            learning frameworks, and the performance- or efficiency-oriented hardware backends.

twill.name: Twill
twill.description:
Twill is an abstraction over Apache Hadoop YARN that reduces the complexity of
            developing distributed applications, allowing developers to focus more on their business
            logic

uniffle.name: Uniffle
uniffle.description: Uniffle is an unified Remote Shuffle Service

unomi.name: Unomi
unomi.description:
Unomi is a reference implementation of the OASIS Context Server specification
            currently being worked on by the OASIS Context Server Technical Committee. It provides a
            high-performance user profile and event tracking server.

usergrid.name: Usergrid
usergrid.description:
Usergrid is Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) composed of an integrated database
            (Cassandra), application layer and client tier with SDKs for developers.

vcl.name: VCL
vcl.description:
Virtual Computing Lab. Framework for creating, dispensing and running virtual
            images.

vxquery.name: VXQuery
vxquery.description: A standards compliant XML Query processor.

wadi.name: WADI
wadi.description:
a robust hetorgeneous clustering engine used to cluster geronimo, tomcat, jetty
            and other containers eventually.

warble.name: Warble
warble.description:
a distributed endpoint monitoring solution where the agent is hosted on your
            own hardware.

wave.name: Wave
wave.description:
A wave is a hosted, live, concurrent data structure for rich communication. It
            can be used like email, chat, or a document.

wayang.name: Wayang
wayang.description:
Wayang is a cross-platform data processing system that aims at decoupling the
            business logic of data analytics applications from concrete data processing platforms,
            such as Apache Flink or Apache Spark. Hence, it tames the complexity that arises from
            the "Cambrian explosion" of novel data processing platforms that we currently witness.

weex.name: Weex
weex.description: Weex is a framework for building Mobile cross-platform high performance UI.

whirr.name: Whirr
whirr.description:
Whirr provides code for running a variety of software services on cloud
            infrastructure.

wicket.name: Wicket
wicket.description:
A web application framework that focusses on bringing plain object oriented
            Java programming to the web tier

wink.name: Wink
wink.description:
Apache Wink is a project that enables development and consumption of REST style
            web services. The core server runtime is based on the JAX-RS (JSR 311) standard. The
            project also introduces a client runtime which can leverage certain components of the
            server-side runtime. Apache Wink will deliver component technology that can be easily
            integrated into a variety of environments.

wookie.name: Wookie
wookie.description: a W3C widget engine with Google Wave and Open Social Extensions.

wsrp4j.name: WSRP4J
wsrp4j.description: Implementation of OASIS Web Services for Remote Portlets (WSRP)

xap.name: XAP
xap.description: Declarative framework for building Ajax-powered web apps

xmlbeans.name: XMLBeans
xmlbeans.description:
XML-Java binding tool with 100% support for XML Schema and full Infoset
            fidelity

xtable.name: XTable
xtable.description:
XTable is an omni-directional converter for table formats that facilitates
            interoperability across data processing systems and query engines.

casbin.name: Casbin
casbin.description:
Casbin is a powerful, open-source access control framework that provides a
            unified, model-driven approach to authorization.

yunikorn.name: YuniKorn
yunikorn.description:
YuniKorn is a standalone resource scheduler responsible for scheduling batch
            jobs and long-running services on large scale distributed systems running in on-premises
            environments as well as different public clouds.

zeppelin.name: Zeppelin
zeppelin.description:
A collaborative data analytics and visualization tool for distributed,
            general-purpose data processing systems such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, etc.

zetacomponents.name: Zeta Components
zetacomponents.description: Zeta Components is a high-quality library of loosely-coupled PHP components.

zipkin.name: Zipkin
zipkin.description:
Zipkin is a distributed tracing system. It helps gather timing data needed to
            troubleshoot latency problems in microservice architectures.
